items.why: AMD leads the chip sector lower as Nvidia extends its six day losing streak and the AI selloff deepens.
The fear gauge jumps as the snowballing selloff in global markets has investors reaching for cover.

summary: Stocks are getting hit hard today, with the Nasdaq wiping out its 2026 gain as the AI selloff worsens. The major indexes are headed for their worst week since liberation day as the Anthropic IPO fails to ease AI worries.
